notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasures.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
You may also instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.
